picks.reasoning: Everyone is hyped on GEN's win streak, but BLG's lanes win harder and their stars carry games alone. They beat T1 and DK with ease, so I'm taking BLG.
BLG's +1.0k GD@15 is the best early-game edge left, and they've been winning the first 15 minutes with jungle tempo and map control all Worlds long. Early lead wins it.
Fearless punishes one-trick pools, and BLG just beat T1 and DK in Bo5s without leaning on comfort picks, so I'm taking their draft depth and adaptability over GEN's hot streak.
GEN tops BLG on series rate, game win rate (75% vs 71%) and record against other regions (9-1). BLG's +1.0k GD@15 keeps this close, so I lean on GEN only lightly.
GEN look like a room that trusts each other: nine wins in ten, sweeps when it matters, and a champion's calm. BLG are scary, but I'm backing the calmer room.
